name: web-dark-testimonial-with-large-portrait-overlapped-by-quote-card-and-social-icons
title: Dark testimonial slider: rounded grey portrait overlapped by a black card with name, role, quote and four round social buttons, arrows and dots
whatItIs: A black canvas with a large rounded portrait of an older man in glasses and olive polo, overlapped by a dark rounded card with a bold name 'William Carter', a grey role, a paragraph quote and four white round social icon buttons, and below outlined circular arrows with three dots.
whatItMeans: Credible and modern; overlap ties the face to the words.
techniques: Overlap a text card over a portrait.

vocabulary.definition: A card placed partly over an image.
A round icon button linking to a profile.
A circular arrow with a border.
